title: Compliance Bulletin: RRP Cleaning Verification on Reconstruction Change Orders that Disturb Painted Surfaces
content:
A drywall, paint or baseboard line on a Reconstruction change order disturbs painted surfaces. Its lead-safe item follows the EPA Renovation, Repair and Painting Rule the company's certified renovators work under, inside the lead-safe setup the permit and fee rule bills on the contract. The lead-safe item is a fixed item of the change order.

**Rule.** On a single-family, condo unit or multifamily unit building built before the tier's RRP year-built cutoff whose contract carries a lead-safe setup charge line:

- a drywall or baseboard line removes painted components, which that rule never treats as minor repair, so its lead-safe item is the lead-safe cleaning verification fee of $125.00 for the RRP cleaning verification of its work area, whatever the area;
- a paint line only prepares painted surfaces, which that rule exempts as minor repair up to the RRP interior minor-repair area of 6 square feet, so its lead-safe item is the $125.00 lead-safe cleaning verification fee when the quantity written on it exceeds 6 square feet, and nothing otherwise.

Every other line, and every line on a contract that carries no lead-safe setup charge line, carries no lead-safe item.

## The year-built cutoff

The RRP year-built cutoff is 1978 on every agreement: Repair Agreement - Minor Repairs 1978, Standard Rebuild Agreement 1978, Major Rebuild Agreement 1978, Full Structural Rebuild Agreement 1978, Multifamily Unit Rebuild Agreement 1978, Commercial Interior Rebuild Agreement 1978. A building built in 1977 or earlier is before the cutoff; one built in 1978 or later is not. The year built is the one on the contract record.

## Decision table (pre-1978 housing whose contract carries a lead-safe setup line)

| Line | Quantity written | Lead-safe item |
|---|---|---|
| drywall | any | $125.00 |
| baseboard | any | $125.00 |
| paint | 6 square feet or less | none |
| paint | more than 6 square feet (for example 6.5) | $125.00 |
| insulation, flooring, cabinet, labor or other | any | none |

| Building | Lead-safe item on a drywall line |
|---|---|
| commercial property, any year | none |
| single-family home built in 1978 | none |
| condo unit built in 1965, contract with no lead-safe setup line | none |
| multifamily unit built in 1965, contract with a lead-safe setup line | $125.00 |
